jobInfo.address: 北京朝阳区融中心A座北京市朝阳区七圣中街12号
jobInfo.postDescription:
Requirement and Skills
• Strong verbal and written communication skill in English, able to produce technical documents in English.
• Familiar using Microsoft 365 products (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, etc.).
• Understand functional and non-functional requirements of software products, design quality assurance and testing strategies for different products.
• Experience with load testing, regression testing, integration testing, e2e testing and incorporation of various testing in development cycle.
• Solid understanding of, and experience with REST-Api code.
• Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting.
• Familiar with Azure resource deployment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skill to identify issues and improve testing processes.
Responsibilities
• Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products.
• Document test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test thoroughly and accurately to maintain comprehensive records.
• Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs.
• Actively participate in Agile/Scrum development processes.
• Effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers, PM, and PO to define and refine test strategies.
• Be willing to support teammates, share knowledge with them, and learn from them.
